Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns, Citing 'Pained' Events; Odisha BJP Uneasy

Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position, citing "pained" events of the past 10 days. His departure has reportedly left the Odisha BJP uneasy regarding the future of Mohan Charan Majhi. The resignation letter's full text has been made public. The future of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) organization is also being discussed following Pradhan's exit.
